name: onecell
description: onecell for Claude Code: durable memory for people and agents.

plugins.name: onecell
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to onecell (MCP) and teaches it the onecell rules: Inbox vs hive, dry runs, search then cite, when to ask you.

plugins.name: onecell-hooks
plugins.description: Optional. Hooks that bring onecell in without being asked: relevant memory on your prompts, a nudge to save what a turn settled, a briefing at session start. Asks for a Drafts only key when enabled; each behaviour is off until you turn it on at onecell.io/settings/agents.
